description: Angular component for OTA package autocomplete, managing OTA package selection, fetching package info, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: OtaPackageAutocompleteComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor for OTA package autocomplete functionality, including form control, package fetching, and display logic.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes to the form control.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for touch events (not implemented).

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up package fetching observable.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: getCurrentEntity
methods.description: Returns the current selected OTA package info if available.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form control.

methods.name: textIsNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a given text string is not empty.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the component's value based on external input, fetching entity info if needed.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updates validation if dirty.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the filtered packages and form control.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change.

methods.name: displayPackageFn
methods.description: Returns display string for a package info object.

methods.name: fetchPackages
methods.description: Fetches OTA packages based on search text and device profile ID.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the current selection and refocuses input.

methods.name: placeholderText
methods.description: Returns placeholder text for input.

methods.name: requiredErrorText
methods.description: Returns error message for required field.

methods.name: notFoundPackage
methods.description: Returns message when package not found.

methods.name: notMatchingPackage
methods.description: Returns message when package does not match.

methods.name: hintText
methods.description: Returns hint text for the input.

methods.name: packageTitleText
methods.description: Formats package title and version for display.
